capabilities: Show log entries in the timelines of linked notes via groups properties
Manage tasks as notes with priorities, labels and deadlines
Track finances and time as transaction and time-entry notes
Run AI agents with scoped vault access, delegation, MCP tools and scripts
Run JavaScript scripts from commands, note headers, links and automations
extras: The manifest carries an unrevised-plugin warning; full user documentation lives inside the plugin rather than in the README, installation is still TODO, and the author states development is now fully agent-driven with bugs expected.
motivation: The author wrote it to consolidate functionality he found missing in Obsidian, rewriting an earlier Dataview-dependent version from scratch to be more universal and independent of other plugins.
problem: Covering logs, task management, journals, finance, time tracking and AI agents normally requires many separate plugins, each with its own storage model that doesn't link together.

relations.evidence: I used to use Firefly III, but I missed the linking Obsidian gives you
The time tracker is my replacement for Toggl
I used to use Templater, which is powerful, but I didn't find it convenient
For reports I use Obsidian's own Bases, which exports a CSV

requires.name: AI model providers and Brave web search
CalDAV or calendar links, self-hosted abele-sync server
GitHub token for issue and PR tabs

summary: All-in-one plugin that adds note-based logs, tasks, journals, finance and time tracking, charts, AI agents, scripts and device sync to Obsidian.
